COMPARE.HELP: Runs the program to the end with both options (and the rest of the configuration) and shows the difference.
COMPARE.FAILED: It could not be compared: load a program without errors.
COMPARE.STOPPED_INPUT: One of the runs stopped when it asked for data in the console: the comparison goes up to there.
COMPARE.STOPPED_ERROR: One of the runs ended with an error: {{error}}
COMPARE.STOPPED_LIMIT: One of the runs reached the limit of 1,000,000 cycles.

MACHINE.CYCLE_CLOCK_DIAGRAM_KEYS: Cycle clock diagram. With the focus, the arrows move it, + and - zoom it, 0 goes back to the initial size, Home goes to the start and End to the last cycle.
MACHINE.DIAGRAM_HELP_TITLE: How to move around the diagram
MACHINE.DIAGRAM_HELP_1: Drag the diagram with the mouse or a finger; two fingers, or Ctrl and the wheel, zoom it.
MACHINE.DIAGRAM_HELP_2: Click the diagram to give it the focus: then the arrows (or J, L, I, K) move it.
MACHINE.DIAGRAM_HELP_3: + and - zoom in and out, and 0 goes back to the initial size.
MACHINE.DIAGRAM_HELP_4: Home (or R) goes to the first cycle and the top of the table; End goes to the last cycle.
MACHINE.DIAGRAM_HELP_5: The diagram follows the last cycle until you move back, and follows it again when you reach the end.
MACHINE.EXPLAIN_RAW: {{label}} in cycle {{cycle}}: {{instruction}} needs {{register}}, which {{cause}} computes, and does not have it yet (data hazard, read after write).
MACHINE.EXPLAIN_RAW_REAL: Forwarding is on: it is a real dependency, the value is not computed yet (for example, a load followed by its use).
MACHINE.EXPLAIN_RAW_FORWARDING_HELPS: With forwarding it would not have stalled in this cycle: the value was already computed, but without forwarding it must wait until it is written in the register (WB).
MACHINE.EXPLAIN_RAW_NOT_YET: In this cycle the value is not computed yet, so it would wait with forwarding too.
MACHINE.EXPLAIN_WAW: {{label}} in cycle {{cycle}}: {{instruction}} writes {{register}}, as {{cause}} does, which is still executing; it waits so as not to write before it (write after write hazard).
MACHINE.EXPLAIN_STRUCTURAL: {{label}} in cycle {{cycle}}: there is no free floating point unit for {{instruction}} (structural hazard). With more units in the configuration it would not wait.
MACHINE.EXPLAIN_MEM: {{label}} in cycle {{cycle}}: {{cause}} uses the MEM stage in this cycle, so {{instruction}} waits for its turn (the floating point units go first).
MACHINE.EXPLAIN_TRAP: {{label}} in cycle {{cycle}}: {{instruction}} is a trap and waits in IF until the pipeline is empty.
MACHINE.EXPLAIN_INPUT: {{label}} in cycle {{cycle}}: {{instruction}} waits for a line of the console.
MACHINE.EXPLAIN_BLOCKED: {{label}} in cycle {{cycle}}: {{instruction}} waits behind {{cause}}, which is stalled.
MACHINE.EXPLAIN_ABORTED: Aborted in cycle {{cycle}}: {{instruction}} had been fetched after {{cause}}, which jumps (branches are predicted not taken) or ends the program.
MACHINE.EXPLAIN_HELP: Click a cell of the diagram, or use the buttons, to see why an instruction stalls.
MACHINE.NO_STALLS: There are no stalls in the diagram.
MACHINE.TABLE_CAPTION: The last {{count}} cycles: the stage or the stall of each instruction in each cycle

CONFIG.HELP_FORWARDING: An instruction gets the result of the previous one as soon as it is computed, without waiting for it to be written in the registers. Without forwarding, each data dependency costs up to two more cycles (R-Stall).
CONFIG.HELP_FLOATING_POINT: How many units of each kind there are and how many cycles each operation takes in them. The units are not pipelined: with only one, a second operation waits for the first to finish (S-Stall).
CONFIG.HELP_MEMORY_SIZE: In bytes, from 512 to 1,048,576 and a multiple of 8. The code starts at 0x100 and the data at 0x1000.
CONFIG.HELP_TIME_SIMULATION: When running (F5), the pause between a cycle and the next one. With 0, as fast as possible.
CONFIG.HELP_AUTO_SAVE: When leaving the editor, saves the file and its breakpoints. Without it, the unsaved changes and the breakpoints are lost.
CONFIG.HELP_MULTIVIEW: Which windows the multiview shows and in which column. They are dragged by their handle.
CONFIG.CONFIRM_MESSAGE: The new configuration loads the program into the simulator again and the simulation going on is lost.
CONFIG.DIAGRAM_HISTORY: History of the cycle clock diagram (cycles)
CONFIG.HELP_DIAGRAM_HISTORY: How many cycles the diagram keeps, from 100 to 100,000; the oldest ones go. A long history makes long programs use more memory.
CONFIG.LOCKED_BY_EXERCISE: This program is a shared exercise: some options are locked and those of the exercise are used.

TOAST.MESSAGE_ERROR_REGEX_MEMORY: Error in memory value, the value is invalid
TOAST.MESSAGE_THE_ADDRESS_MUST_BE_A_MULTIPLE_O: The address must be a multiple of data size ({{text}})
TOAST.MESSAGE_ERROR_IN_ADDRESS_MEMORY: Address not valid, out of memory
TOAST.MESSAGE_NO_ACCOUNTS: There are no accounts in this installation of THUMDER (it has no Firebase keys): you are working as a guest.
TOAST.MESSAGE_ASSEMBLY_ERRORS: It cannot be simulated until they are fixed: they are marked on their lines in the editor.
TOAST.MESSAGE_SIMULATOR_ERROR: The simulator could not finish the operation.
TOAST.MESSAGE_SYNC_PENDING: Your changes could not be sent to your account, so you are still signed in. Check the connection and try again.
TOAST.MESSAGE_BREAKPOINT_STAGE: Stopped at line {{line}}, when it reached {{stage}}.

SIMULATION.LOAD: Load the code into the simulator
SIMULATION.SHORTCUTS: Shortcuts: F5 run or pause, F10 next cycle, Shift+F10 step back, F8 to the end without drawing, Shift+F5 load the code
SIMULATION.RUN_TO_END: Run to the end without drawing

IO.TITLE: Program console (DLX-I/O)
IO.WAITING: The program waits for a line: type it and press Enter

FILE_MANAGER.TITLE: File manager
FILE_MANAGER.UP: Go up to the folder above
FILE_MANAGER.IMPORT_NOTHING: There were no programs (.s or .txt) to import.
FILE_MANAGER.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete {{count}} items? It cannot be undone.
FILE_MANAGER.DROP_HERE: Drop the files to import them
FILE_MANAGER.NAME: Name
FILE_MANAGER.EMPTY: This folder is empty. Create a program, import files or drop them here.
FILE_MANAGER.HELP: Double click or Enter opens; Ctrl+click selects several; F2 renames; Delete deletes. Drag an item to a folder (or to the path above) to move it.
FILE_MANAGER.NAME_TOO_LONG: The name is too long (100 characters at most).
FILE_MANAGER.NAME_RESERVED: That name is reserved by the system.
FILE_MANAGER.NAME_TAKEN: There is already an item with that name in this folder.
FILE_MANAGER.READ_ONLY_HELP: A folder of THUMDER, read only: you can open, run and download its programs. If you change one, a copy is saved in «{{folder}}».
FILE_MANAGER.READ_ONLY_EDITOR: A program of THUMDER, read only: if you change it, saving creates a copy in «{{folder}}».
FILE_MANAGER.READ_ONLY_ERROR: The folders of THUMDER are read only

PROBLEMS.TITLE: Problems
PROBLEMS.NOT_LOADED: Load the code (Shift+F5) to assemble it and see its errors here.
PROBLEMS.NONE: No problems: the program can be simulated.
PROBLEMS.CANNOT_SIMULATE: It cannot be simulated: the program has {{count}} errors. Fix them and load the code again (Shift+F5).

MODULES.TITLE: Modules of {{name}}
MODULES.HELP: The modules are the other .s files of the same folder that are assembled with the program (as «Load Code or Data» of WinDLX).
MODULES.AUTOMATIC: Automatic: those that define with .global the missing symbols
MODULES.NONE: There are no other .s files in this folder.

SYMBOLS.TITLE: Symbols of the program
SYMBOLS.FILTER: Search a symbol or an address
SYMBOLS.NONE: Load the code to see its symbols.
SYMBOLS.NAME: Name

BREAKPOINTS.TITLE: Breakpoints
BREAKPOINTS.LINES_HELP: Breakpoints are set in the margin of the editor. Here you choose the stage where it stops: IF (when the instruction is fetched) or when it reaches ID, EX, MEM or WB.
BREAKPOINTS.NO_LINES: There are no breakpoints: click the left margin of a line of the editor.
BREAKPOINTS.WATCHPOINTS_HELP: The run stops when a load reads or a store writes the watched address.
BREAKPOINTS.INVALID_ADDRESS: Write a hexadecimal address aligned with the size (for example, 0x1004 for 4 bytes).

SHARE.TITLE: Share as an exercise
SHARE.HELP: The link has the program and the configuration of the machine. Whoever opens it gets a copy in the folder «compartidos».
SHARE.LOCK: Lock while the exercise is done
SHARE.TOO_LONG: The program is too long for a link.
SHARE.INVALID: The link is not a valid exercise: it may be incomplete.

EDITOR.TOGGLE_BREAKPOINT: Set or remove a breakpoint on the line of the cursor

EXERCISES.TITLE: Guided exercises
EXERCISES.HELP: Each exercise opens a program of the examples with its configuration (locked while you do it). Run it to the end (F5 or F8), look at the diagram and the statistics and answer: the answers are checked against the simulation.
EXERCISES.RUN_FIRST: Run the program to the end to check the answers.
EXERCISES.FAILED: The list of exercises could not be loaded.

DATAPATH.TITLE: The datapath of the pipeline of THUMDER, with what each stage does in this cycle
DATAPATH.WRITE_BACK: WB writes in the registers (in the first half of the cycle)
DATAPATH.NO_FORWARDING: No forwarding: the values are only read from the registers

STATUS.INPUT: Waiting for a line of the console

NOT_FOUND.TITLE: Error 404
NOT_FOUND.HEADING: The page cannot be found.
NOT_FOUND.TEXT: The address does not exist in THUMDER.

MULTIVIEW.FLOAT: Float as a window (move it by its title and resize it from its edges; Alt+arrows move it and Alt+Shift+arrows resize it)
MULTIVIEW.DOCK: Put the window back in its column
